question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 8 AND (text ILIKE '%solid con%' OR text ILIKE '%primary drying%' OR text ILIKE '%51 s%' OR text ILIKE '%65 wt%' OR text ILIKE '%45 wt%' OR text ILIKE '%34 s%' OR text ILIKE '%shortens%' OR text ILIKE '%increasing the solid%' OR text ILIKE '%from 45%' OR text ILIKE '%to 65%') ORDER BY id

WITH s AS (SELECT string_agg(text, ' ' ORDER BY id) AS t FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p8.L31','p8.L32')),
d AS (SELECT string_agg(text, ' ' ORDER BY id) AS t FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p8.L34','p8.L35'))
SELECT
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM s), 'from\s+(\d+)\s*wt', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS solids_old,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM s), 'to\s+(\d+)\s*wt', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS solids_new,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM d), 'from\s+(\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS dry_old,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM d), 'to\s+(\d+)\s*s', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS dry_new,
 100.0*(CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM s), 'to\s+(\d+)\s*wt', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM s), 'from\s+(\d+)\s*wt', 1) AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM s), 'from\s+(\d+)\s*wt', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS solids_rise_pct,
 100.0*(CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM d), 'from\s+(\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM d), 'to\s+(\d+)\s*s', 1) AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT t FROM d), 'from\s+(\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS drying_cut_pct

rendered: Replacing the PVDF binder with PVDF latex and CMC raises the solids content of the NMC 532[1] slurry from 45 wt%[2] to 65 wt%[3], without increasing the slurry viscosity. That is a relative rise of 44[4] percent. The higher solids content shortens the primary drying time of the graphite coating from 51 s[5] to 34 s[6], a cut of 33[7] percent of the primary drying time.
